# rework r3 claims — purchases_returns_and_price_adjustments

- R2-N1 → the Bonus Card shortfall problem is retired, because no record lets a redemption be classed as Bonus Card versus gift card without a card-kind join. The gift card shortfall claim now covers every Marlowe & Finch card redemption naming the unit, Bonus Cards included, in its scope sentence, overwrite, formula and size goodwill alike. The second prerequisite of the claim is now a Finch Note tax refund (new policy and tool): under the company tax schedule a Finch Note is a store discount, so the sales tax charged on its part is refunded on its own, and the note shortfall refund no longer refunds that tax. Task 1's world now has the Bonus Card issued and unredeemed; its tree, persona and proof text were rebuilt.
- R2-N2 → the duplicate-capture policy's scope, second-capture formula, day count, bank-fee tiers and the claim's edge condition all name the tender of the unit's latest capture being captured more than once. One capture per tender on a mixed-tender unit counts as a single payment, as in the base allocation rule.
- Class sweep (restrictions) → every restriction added for first-match safety now appears in each passage that refers to the same object: active membership, active card, the registry through the ledger entry's registry, the capture tender. No status restriction remains on Bonus Cards or gift cards.
- Class sweep (base rules) → every shortfall cap measures money captured by tenders other than gift cards, consistent with the base rule that records a gift card part as its own capture. Every register-error carve-out names all six sibling kinds, the new tax kind included. The note-tax wording matches the base capture formula and the loyalty rule that notes never pay tax.
- Probes → on scratch copies the figures behave as the rules state: an expired second Bonus Card redeemed on the unit is counted by the claim, as its scope says; closed cards and a closed earlier membership listed first change nothing; a correctly recorded mixed-tender unit yields no second capture and no shortfall.
- CG-O1 → considered. Corrections still share one record shape, but each prerequisite sentence names its own error kind, and no world has two kinds that a single correction could satisfy.
- CG-O5 → considered. Every rounding sentence sits where the compute rounds, and no half-cent tie arises in either world.
- CG-O8 → considered. The escalation and paid-share tiers are the declared value channel of the prerequisite edges.
- T1-O1 → the records on task 1's unit now show only the eGift card and the note. The persona names the eGift card and says nothing else comes to mind, so there is no conflict with the records.
- Task 0 → no change to its tree, world or figures; gates re-run green.
